title: Mobile navigation drawer announces a hard-coded English name and description ("Sidebar" / "Displays the mobile sidebar.") in every locale
body:
## What happens

On a phone, the navigation drawer (bottom bar → 更多) is a dialog whose accessible name and description are hard-coded English, whatever the user's language:

- name: `Sidebar`
- description: `Displays the mobile sidebar.`

Everything visible inside the drawer is translated (zh-CN here: 搜索菜单, 点星标把菜单项固定到底部栏…), so a screen-reader user of a zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES workspace hears an English announcement on opening it, then the translated menu.

Observed on `@objectstack/*` 18.6.0 at 375×812, user locale zh-CN; still the same on `main`.

## Where

`ui/packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx`, the mobile branch of `Sidebar`:

```tsx
<SheetHeader className="sr-only">
  <SheetTitle>Sidebar</SheetTitle>
  <SheetDescription>Displays the mobile sidebar.</SheetDescription>
</SheetHeader>
```

## Expected

Both strings come from the console's translations (or from props the shell passes), like the rest of the drawer. Scope: screen-reader text only, nothing visible changes.

## Steps

1. Sign in with a non-English locale, open any app at a phone width.
2. Tap 更多 in the bottom bar.
3. Inspect the dialog's accessible name / description.
